items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Well, ain't but one guy that seems like Eddie Morris, probably the only one.

ctx.x: Well, is anybody alive who plays much like Jack Carey, or any recordings that are much on his style?

Well, ain't but one guy that seems like Eddie Morris, probably the only one. Cause all the rest of them, probably, they, uh, the way they play trombone now, they feel like they play trompones. Yeah, they all play in the lead. Yeah, but Eddie Morris got more, you know, that style, playing sides and stuff, you know, sides. They had a fellow named Morris French. I don't know what would come of him. He's up in Laplace.

items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Well, I know Punch from playing with Jack Carey. And somehow or another they fell out or something and then I took Georgia Boy, that's the clarinet player and Punch and Walter Preston and Joe Gable.

ctx.x: And when did you start playing with Punch? When did you first meet Punch? Do you remember?

Well, I know Punch from playing with Jack Carey. And somehow or another they fell out or something and then I took Georgia Boy, that's the clarinet player and Punch and Walter Preston and Joe Gable. Then we went together and we was buying up everything we see and everything. We was in on one train going out on another. I believe we the first man started traveling, yeah, after Lewis left.
Going excursions mostly or what time?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: they had Ewan, Eddie Morris, and Kent Thomas.

ctx.x: Two boys from Wisconsin. Yeah. Joel Salter and Doggy. I think Doggy's name was Burger. And they, let's see, they had Ewan, Eddie Morris, and Kent Thomas.
Back to those brass bands here. Well, the Silverleaf brass band, they wouldn't really be playing too much music then, huh? No. Well. They'd be faking a lot of it, huh? Yeah.

Silverleaf had some good musicians. Tuxedo had some good musicians. Now, you take, well, we'd call them the Zulu band. They had a hot brass band, see? Black Benny, myself, Lewis, and what does Tramon play our name? Eddie Morris. Not Eddie Morris. Morris. Morris. Morris French. Morris French played Tramon with Rene. Yeah.
